verdict.rationale: Clara documents a few configurable behaviors that run on their own: cards can be set to auto-delete at a period end date, and spend limits reset on a daily, weekly or monthly schedule. Its marketing also claims automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance, plus an automated CFO agent, but there is no documented way for users to build their own general background automations. Webhooks and the API are only building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or workflow builder, recurring scheduled automations beyond limit resets, detail on how the automated approvals or CFO agent are set up and run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
